I don't have any notes on Esther 9 for you yet. My first attempt to load eight sources at once hit the tool's usage limit, and the tool then stopped accepting calls, so I couldn't open any pages. You asked me to report only what the pages say and to give a URL for every point, so I've left the notes blank rather than fill them from memory.

When you start a new turn, I'll fetch the pages one or two at a time so I don't hit the limit again. These are the pages I'd planned to read for each part of your request:

- Ellicott: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/esther/9.htm

- Precept Austin's Esther pages

**2. Where Protestant traditions differ**
- Wesley's Notes (wesley.nnu.edu)
- Spurgeon's sermons on Esther (spurgeon.org)
- Desiring God or The Gospel Coalition, on the Jews' self-defence in vv. 5–16 and on why God isn't named in Esther
- Lutheran comment on Esther (lcms.org or 1517.org)

**3. Other views**
- NET Bible notes: https://netbible.org/bible/Esther+9
- Bible Odyssey's articles on Esther and Purim
- The Catholic Encyclopedia's Esther article on newadvent.org (Catholic Bibles include extra Greek chapters of Esther)
- I'll only add a popular modern teaching (such as prosperity or word-of-faith) if one of the sites actually discusses Esther 9.

Reply "continue" and I'll start with Enduring Word and the Bible Hub commentaries, then build out the verse-by-verse notes.
